newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Uniwear says Pex Euro.NM plan snagged.
newsitem.headline: Uniwear says Pex Euro.NM plan snagged.

text.p: Belgian textile holding company Uniwear said on Wednesday plans to seek a second listing for its British unit Pex had hit a "technical" glitch.

"Some requirements of the Euro.NM market are not in accordance with those of the London Stock Exchange," Uniwear finance director Yves De Poorter told a news conference on the results of a capital increase that closed last week.
At a news conference last month to present the share issue, Uniwear said it hoped to make Pex the first non-Belgian company to list on the Brussels bourse's Euro.NM segment.
De Poorter said the problems, which included accountancy rules, remain to be resolved following a meeting with the Brussels Stock Exchange two weeks ago.
He reiterated, however, that it still was the company's intention to list Pex in continental Europe.

The Brussels segment of the Euro.NM or New Market, being developed jointly by the Belgian, Dutch, German and French bourses, is due to kick off this month with the listing of Belgian cancer treatment firm International Brachytherapy (IBt).
